question: The volume of a cylinder is 5500 cm³. If its curved surface area is 4400 sq.cm, then find its height.
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of the cylinder (V) = 5500 cm³

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 4400 cm²

**Formula used:**

Volume of the cylinder (V) = πr²h

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

From the formula of CSA, 2πrh = 4400

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r × h = 4400</p&g
